actors.name: Entry Buyer / Ticket Owner / Ticket Recipient
Permissionless Caller (Draw Requester, Refund Enabler, Settler, Claim Releaser)

candidates.name: createRaffle
candidates.why: Validates untrusted sponsor parameters and sale duration, deploys and initializes a Raffle clone, updates factory registries, escrows the untrusted ERC-721 prize via safeTransferFrom, and enforces post-transfer ownership and Status.Active invariants (L97-L148).

candidates.name: buyEntries
candidates.why: Validates active sale status, timestamp, and uint128 entry bounds, pulls USDC from the buyer, mutates totalEntries, ticketCount, _ticketRanges, and unsettledPot, and safe-mints an ERC-721 range ticket to an untrusted recipient (L209-L237).

candidates.name: _settleWinningTicket
candidates.why: Enforces single settlement in NftWon/CashWon states, verifies the supplied ticket range contains winningEntry, and partitions unsettledPot into protocolFees, winnerProceeds, and remainder sponsorProceeds (L533-L558).

candidates.name: redeemWinningTicket
candidates.why: Enforces winning-ticket ownership and single redemption, lazily settles if needed, burns the winning ticket, updates redemption state, and delivers either the ERC-721 prize (with ownerOf verification) or USDC winnerProceeds (L309-L346).

candidates.name: requestDraw
candidates.why: Enforces the post-sale draw request window, nonzero totalEntries, and VRF fee coverage, transitions status to Drawing, calls the Chainlink wrapper with _requestInFlight guard, and refunds excess native ETH to msg.sender via low-level call (L240-L273).

candidates.name: fulfillRandomWords
candidates.why: Processes the wrapper-authenticated VRF callback, softly ignoring callbacks that are in-flight, out-of-status, wrong-requestId, wrong-word-count, or at/after callbackDeadline(), and otherwise sets winningEntry, resolvedAt, and NftWon/CashWon status (L509-L524).

candidates.name: enableRefunds
candidates.why: Enforces state-specific timeout deadlines (or early sponsor cancellation when totalEntries == 0), moves unsettledPot into remainingRefundLiability, and transitions the raffle to Status.Refunding (L276-L301).

candidates.name: refundTickets
candidates.why: Enforces Status.Refunding, bounded batch size, and caller ownership of each ticket, burns tickets while accumulating entry counts from _ticketRanges, decrements remainingRefundLiability, and transfers USDC refunds (L349-L372).

candidates.name: _validateCreateParams
candidates.why: Validates untrusted CreateRaffleParams by checking contract code on prizeToken, nonzero sponsorRecipient, protocol-destination screening, ERC-165 IERC721 support on prizeToken, and nonzero reserveEntries (L154-L179).

candidates.name: initialize
candidates.why: Enforces one-time initialization restricted to the canonical factory, screens configured addresses against zero and _isProtocolDestination, persists raffle configuration in clone storage, and sets Status.AwaitingPrize (L176-L206).

candidates.name: onERC721Received
candidates.why: Enforces that ERC-721 safeTransferFrom acceptance only occurs in Status.AwaitingPrize from prizeToken for prizeTokenId with from == sponsor and operator == factory, transitioning status to Status.Active (L416-L431).

candidates.name: _isProtocolDestination
candidates.why: Screens addresses against the clone itself, factory, quoteToken, VRF wrapper, prizeToken, raffleImplementation, and factory-registered Raffle clones so tickets and payouts cannot be stranded in protocol plumbing (L593-L605).

candidates.name: releaseSponsorPrize
candidates.why: Enforces Status.CashWon or Status.Refunding and single prize claim, marks prizeClaimed, transfers the escrowed ERC-721 prize to sponsorRecipient, and verifies post-transfer ownerOf (L395-L407).

candidates.name: releaseSponsorProceeds
candidates.why: Enforces nonzero sponsorProceeds, zeroes the storage liability before external interaction, and transfers the USDC amount to sponsorRecipient via _transferQuote (L375-L382).

candidates.name: releaseProtocolFees
candidates.why: Enforces nonzero protocolFees, zeroes the storage liability before external interaction, and transfers the USDC amount to protocolTreasury via _transferQuote (L385-L392).

candidates.name: _update
candidates.why: Overrides ERC721._update to reject ticket mints and transfers to _isProtocolDestination addresses while permitting burns to address(0) across all lifecycle states (L497-L502).

candidates.name: _transferQuote
candidates.why: Enforces !_isProtocolDestination(to, address(prizeToken)) before transferring quoteToken via SafeERC20.safeTransfer (L564-L567).

candidates.name: _requireWinningTicket
candidates.why: Verifies that the selected one-based winningEntry lies within a candidate ticketId's stored [firstEntry, lastEntry] range (L579-L585).

candidates.name: constructor
candidates.why: Validates contract code on quoteToken_ and vrfWrapper_, checks 6-decimal metadata on quoteToken_, screens protocolTreasury_ against protocol addresses and the newly deployed Raffle implementation, and locks factory immutables (L65-L92).

candidates.name: constructor
candidates.why: Validates nonzero factory, quoteToken_, and vrfWrapper_, binds shared implementation immutables, and permanently locks the implementation contract in Status.Refunding with initialized = true (L155-L166).

candidates.name: settleWinningTicket
candidates.why: External nonReentrant entrypoint allowing any caller to trigger _settleWinningTicket independently of ticket redemption (L304-L306).

entrypoints.name: constructor
entrypoints.reachableBy: Factory deployer once at RaffleFactory deployment (L65-L92).

entrypoints.name: createRaffle
entrypoints.reachableBy: Any external caller (prospective sponsor) supplying CreateRaffleParams and an approved ERC-721 prize (L97-L148).

entrypoints.name: constructor
entrypoints.reachableBy: RaffleFactory constructor once when deploying the shared Raffle implementation (L155-L166).

entrypoints.name: receive
entrypoints.reachableBy: Any external caller sending native currency with empty calldata; always reverts with DirectNativeTransfer (L171-L173).

entrypoints.name: initialize
entrypoints.reachableBy: Only the immutable RaffleFactory contract (msg.sender == factory) once per fresh clone during createRaffle (L176-L206).

entrypoints.name: onERC721Received
entrypoints.reachableBy: Only the configured prizeToken contract (msg.sender == address(prizeToken)) when operator == factory and from == sponsor in Status.AwaitingPrize during createRaffle (L416-L431).

entrypoints.name: buyEntries
entrypoints.reachableBy: Any external caller during Status.Active before endTime who has approved quoteToken to the Raffle clone (L209-L237).

entrypoints.name: requestDraw
entrypoints.reachableBy: Any external caller (permissionless) sending sufficient native ETH during [endTime, drawRequestDeadline()) while Status.Active and totalEntries > 0 (L240-L273).

entrypoints.name: rawFulfillRandomWords
entrypoints.reachableBy: Only the immutable Chainlink VRF v2.5 wrapper (msg.sender == address(i_vrfV2PlusWrapper)), which dispatches to Raffle.fulfillRandomWords (L101-L107).

entrypoints.name: enableRefunds
entrypoints.reachableBy: The configured sponsor before endTime when Status.Active and totalEntries == 0, or any external caller permissionlessly at/after the applicable deadline in Status.Active or Status.Drawing (L276-L301).

entrypoints.name: settleWinningTicket
entrypoints.reachableBy: Any external caller permissionlessly when status is Status.NftWon or Status.CashWon and settlementComplete is false (L304-L306).

entrypoints.name: redeemWinningTicket
entrypoints.reachableBy: Only the current ERC-721 owner of the winning ticketId when status is Status.NftWon or Status.CashWon and winnerRedeemed is false (L309-L346).

entrypoints.name: refundTickets
entrypoints.reachableBy: Only the current ERC-721 owner of all supplied ticketIds (1 to 100 tickets) when status is Status.Refunding (L349-L372).

entrypoints.name: releaseSponsorProceeds
entrypoints.reachableBy: Any external caller permissionlessly whenever sponsorProceeds > 0 after settlement (L375-L382).

entrypoints.name: releaseProtocolFees
entrypoints.reachableBy: Any external caller permissionlessly whenever protocolFees > 0 after settlement (L385-L392).

entrypoints.name: releaseSponsorPrize
entrypoints.reachableBy: Any external caller permissionlessly when status is Status.CashWon or Status.Refunding and prizeClaimed is false (L395-L407).

entrypoints.name: transferFrom / safeTransferFrom / approve / setApprovalForAll
entrypoints.reachableBy: Any ticket owner or approved operator on a Raffle clone to manage or transfer ERC-721 range tickets, routed through Raffle._update (L93-L136).

modules.name: Raffle
modules.role: ERC-1167 clone implementation for an autonomous single-NFT raffle that escrows one ERC-721 prize, sells fixed-price USDC entry ranges as transferable ERC-721 tickets, requests and receives Chainlink VRF v2.5 randomness, settles quote-token liabilities, and processes pull-based redemptions, refunds, and fee/proceeds claims.

modules.name: RaffleFactory
modules.role: Ownerless, immutable factory and canonical registry that deploys the locked Raffle implementation in its constructor and atomically deploys, initializes, registers, and escrows prizes into ERC-1167 Raffle clones.

modules.name: RaffleConstants
modules.role: Internal constants library defining basis-point fee/payout splits, 1 USDC (1e6) entry price, 6-decimal quote token requirement, refund batch size cap (100), sale duration cap (30 days), draw/callback timeouts (2 days each), and VRF callback gas/confirmation parameters.

modules.name: IRaffle
modules.role: Interface for Raffle defining the Status lifecycle enum, RaffleInitParams struct, events, custom errors, and external function signatures.

modules.name: IRaffleFactory
modules.role: Interface for RaffleFactory defining the CreateRaffleParams struct, RaffleCreated event, custom errors, and external factory and registry function signatures.

state.name: sponsor, sponsorRecipient, protocolTreasury, prizeToken, prizeTokenId, raffleId, reserveEntries, endTime
